bugs.title: Off-by-one overdue fine calculation
bugs.symptom: Members returned books on the exact due date or 1 day late are charged an extra day of fine ($1.50 extra).
bugs.root_cause: The ChronoUnit.DAYS.between already computes the exact difference between two dates. Adding '+ 1' artificially inflates overdue days.
bugs.remediation: Remove '+ 1' and calculate fine strictly as ChronoUnit.DAYS.between(loan.getDueDate(), returnDate).

bugs.title: Race condition in stock checkout allowing overselling
bugs.symptom: When book available copies is 1, concurrent checkouts cause available stock to become negative (-1), corrupting physical inventory counts.
bugs.root_cause: Non-atomic check-then-act pattern without mutex or synchronized block on the inventory record.
bugs.remediation: Synchronize the decrementStock method or use an AtomicInteger / database row lock (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE) during stock decrements.

bugs.title: NullPointerException during reservation queue insertion
bugs.symptom: java.lang.NullPointerException crash during member reservation when member record has null tier.
bugs.root_cause: The PriorityQueue comparator accesses .getTier().getPriority() directly without checking if getTier() is null.
bugs.remediation: Add null check: default null tier to MemberTier.REGULAR or check (tier != null ? tier.getPriority() : MemberTier.REGULAR.getPriority()).
